meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Trained Like A Victoria's Secret Model for 5 Weeks, I Trained Like a NASA Astronaut, I Tried Marine Bootcamp, I Tried FBI Hostage Negotiation, I Tried FBI Academy
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
